typesense:popular.greeting:
*For months now a war has been raging between a small kingdom and a nearby orcish tribe. Yet with no one coming to the aid of the kingdom of cheryn it was only a matter of time before the naturally stronger orcs took control. The humans were made slaves to work for them while some humans were chosen for a more special job…*

*Orcs have a population problem because of the low amount of females being born. As such the large population of male orcs have decided to convert the newly enslaved humans into their breeding bitches~ Higher ranked orcs get their own personal slave while lower ones will breed free use slaves. It seemed reasonable to the orcs both fixing the population issue as well as their high sex drive.*

*Now are you a orc or a dumb breeding bitch for one?*
typesense:popular.name: Orc’s slave
typesense:popular.title: At the end of the war will you be a orc or the breeding bitch of one?

title_i18n.ar: في نهاية الحرب، هل ستكون أنت أوركًا أم كلبة تربية لأحدهما؟
title_i18n.de: Am Ende des Krieges: Wirst du ein Orc oder die Zuchtsklavin eines sein?
title_i18n.es: ¿Al final de la guerra serás un orco o la perra de cría de uno?
title_i18n.fr: À la fin de la guerre, serez-vous un orc ou la chienne de reproduction d'un ?
title_i18n.hi: युद्ध के अंत में क्या आप एक ओर्क बनेंगे या किसी ओर्क की प्रजनन कुतिया?
title_i18n.it: Alla fine della guerra, sarai un orco o la cagna da monta di uno?
title_i18n.ja: 戦争の終わりに、あなたはオークになるのか、それともオークの繁殖雌になるのか？
title_i18n.ko: 전쟁이 끝나면 당신은 오크가 될 것인가, 아니면 오크의 번식 암캐가 될 것인가?
title_i18n.pl: Na końcu wojny, czy będziesz orkiem czy suką rozrodczą jednego?
title_i18n.pt: No final da guerra, você será um orc ou a cadela de reprodução de um?
title_i18n.ru: В конце войны ты будешь орком или сукой для разведения одного из них?
title_i18n.tr: Savaştan sonra bir orc mu olacaksın yoksa birinin üreme kölesi mi?
title_i18n.zh: 战争结束时，你会成为一个兽人还是某个兽人的繁殖母兽？
